div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

• TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3 Termination (Let's Encrypt)
• Rate Limiter (60 req/min/IP, Burst 20)
• OWASP Top 10 Security Headers
• Gzip / Brotli Static Compression

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

• Map Connection Upgrade for SignalR
• Proxy Read Timeout: 3600s

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
smartfb-frontend (Port: 3000)
• Next.js 14 App Router (Node.js 20 Alpine)
• 5 Route Groups: (customer), (kds), (staff), (manager), (admin)
• Standalone Server Output Mode

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

• ASP.NET Core 8 Web API (Clean Architecture)
• MediatR CQRS Command/Query Handlers
• FluentValidation & RFC 7807 ProblemDetails

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

• /hubs/kitchen (KDS Điều Phối Bếp)
• /hubs/payments (PayOS Webhook Notify)
• /hubs/notifications (Chuông Gọi Bàn & Alert)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

• Scheduled Job: Tự Động Đóng Ca & Cảnh Báo Kho
• Seasonal Menu Activation Scheduler

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
smartfb-postgres (Port: 5432)
• 25 Thực Thể Chuẩn Hóa 3NF
• Connection Pooling (Npgsql: Min 10, Max 100)
• JSONB Dynamic Modifiers & Timescale Logs
• Persistent Volume: postgres_data

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

• Redis 7 Alpine with AOF & RDB Snapshot
• Cache-Aside Pattern (Menu, Table, CRM)
• RedLock Distributed Locking (Bàn, KDS, Idempotency)
• Redis Pub/Sub SignalR Multi-instance Backplane
